utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and connect anyone who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. What’s still left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’m checking the list now, and I’ll let you know which tools we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can spread the word and connect folks who want to pitch in—what time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—I’m still fuzzy on the exact time. I know the gate and a couple lane markers need work, though.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not much yet — we’re still sorting the repair drive details. I’ll let you know as soon as the plan’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—just let me know when the plan’s set and what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday morning at the community center on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — I’m here now, so fill me in and I’ll help out Saturday morning at the community center on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’m still planning on Saturday morning at the community center on Maple, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me — I’ll plan on Saturday morning at the community center on Maple. Just send any updates if the plan changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the repair drive details, but I can help if you need anything. What should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you check the gate and the lane markers first? I want to make sure we’ve got the exact repair items before I help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let me know which repair drive spot you want me to check first, and I’ll keep track of any updates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — could you point me to the first repair drive location to check? I’ll keep an eye on any updates.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s happening — just send me the list from the first stop, and I’ll bring whatever tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check the first stop list and send over whatever tools we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s definitely happening — I’m hearing folks are lining up supplies and volunteer slots already.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. What still feels most urgent — tools, parts, or extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help—just tell me the plan for the repair drive and what time you need me there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly tools and a few extra hands—can you come by around 10?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the tool list, then I can swing by and see what else we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Ira — I’ll send the tool list as soon as I have it, and the drive is still set for Sunday at the community center.
